title: Determine exact ordinary Toeplitz generator counts for tensor Gaussian kernels and their inverses
body:
## Result and relevance
Proves exact ordinary displacement rank and minimum lower-times-upper Toeplitz generator count 2T/n_fast for normalized tensor Gaussian kernels and their inverses; best lexicographic axis order gives 2T/max n_i. This identifies a missing representation obligation in grouped recovery.

## Pins and novelty
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Extends the retained shallow generator mechanism with explicit boundary minors, Gaussian invertibility and inverse Schur/persymmetry proof. Credits the normalized-core sources and #5566, #5571, #6905; no literature-wide priority claim.

## Reproduction and checks
Run `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-gaussian-displacement-rank`. Exact rational normal/-O replay, selected-minor Bareiss checks, generator reconstruction and scope controls pass. Separate proof review is in REVIEW.md. Committed bytes/modes and export checks pass. Full-history gate is not claimed for the shallow checkout; exact canonical provenance and base ancestry were checked.

## Limits and kappa
A representation result, not a runtime lower bound. Arbitrary permutations, approximate rank, paid gauges and the complete recovery caller remain open. No new kappa: selected 0.00363005817 and all five assumptions remain.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; predecessor authors and classical structured-matrix work are credited. Separate agent review is not human/formal acceptance.

[Full proof, dependencies, checks and open obligations](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/326844a3e0c570fdafa4f3737095cd37154743a6/research/tensor-gaussian-displacement-rank/PR-DESCRIPTION.md).

title: Prove that Cp-bit rounding preserves the ordinary generator obstruction for normalized Gaussian tensors
body:
## Result and relevance
Proves explicit perturbation margins preserving at least2T/n_fast ordinary Toeplitz generator terms for normalized Gaussian tensors and inverse targets. With polynomial axis sizes, logarithmic Gaussian parameters, phase gap Omega(p^-2) and g<=p^beta for fixed beta<1, the margin costs O(g log p)=o(p) bits. Cp-bit entry and factor-table rounding eventually preserve the obstruction.

## Novelty and sources
Quantitative extension of the exact boundary-minor package326844a. Exact canonical source pins and prior accretive-symbol/fine-prime attribution are retained, including #1786. No literature-wide priority claim.

## Checks
Registered exact normal/-O replay passes27 arbitrary-A cases,6 tensors,39 PSD gap certificates and substantive failure controls. Independent root proof/source review, eight canonical pins, byte/mode, ancestry and export checks pass.

## Limits
This concerns matrix representations, not arbitrary layouts, nonlinear rounded algorithms or runtime. Full gauged/periodic recovery and source-to-core transfer remain open. No practical source cutoff is claimed.

## Base, kappa and credit

title: Selected MOVE24472: execute the complete frozen native move through a paid old-coded entrance and original-owner return
body:
## Exact result and why it matters

The complete selected MOVE24472 was already implemented on a supplied
packed field. Its old-codec/strided entrance and return remained separate
caller work. This package joins the new paid bridge to that **unchanged
complete core**: one uninterrupted 88,816-instruction program on 72 tapes
enters through OLD23/three-bit-coded data, executes both monomials,
translation and every central C axis, and returns the exact result to the
original old-coded owner.

The fixed source is selected #7000 event `["MOVE",415,3,99,false]`, index
24472, with complete frames `[] -> [239]`. The proof preserves every row,
coefficient index, spectator, numerical quantum and absolute phase. All
72 heads return; the original 43 guards persist; 29 new guards and all
70 private bodies are retired. No runtime host callback implements a gap.

## Complete cost and numerical domain

For old physical volume V_old and descriptor length E:

```
T <= 2^25 (f V_old + E + 1)
K_after <= K_entry + 2048 (V_old + E + 1).
```

Both codecs, all 18f address passes, all six factors, descriptors, staging,
source access, original-owner commit, guards and returns are included.
Erasure never refunds history. The unchanged graph retains direct
Theta(f V_old+E) cost; no accelerated nonleaf tariff is claimed.

The general domain requires every phase negation to fit and every C-axis
prefix to be integral and fit the signed width. The selected complete-root
invariant **before** the right monomial implies this domain at unchanged
quantum 2^-(p+n), width p+h+2n+3. Its strict magnitude bound excludes
most-negative-word phase overflow; no extra 2^f input reserve is needed.

An independently derived control shows why endpoint fit alone is too weak:
at f=1,w=2, real −2 at native a0=a7=1 (old address258) has fitting integral
complete outputs, but the actual right phase requires +2. The literal
join rejects before C with zero old public writes. The existing endpoint
and once-rounded widened wrappers retain their distinct domains and bills;
neither is silently imported here.

## Exact sources and novelty

- Canonical base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`.
- Paid bridge: [CubeJerry30497f40](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/30497f40d89f2a137a4bc31a4fee1229b9af1440/research/selected-move-packed-codec).
- Existing full unscaled core: CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#7563 at
  `5dd80e8ab9c989336b5e448e14147c2ba29da89b`.
- Common-root predecessor: CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#7578 at
  `e9b6d75397e3553af77bab81d5816e4b8708a501`.

All 32 retained files have exact byte, Git-blob and SHA256 pins. The original
bridge, full core and its small dependency closure remain unchanged. The
packed MOVE, factor algorithms, source normalization and tensor identities
are credited predecessor work. The new result is the complete paid old
physical boundary and its pre-right admission/return composition.

## Reproduction and executed checks

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/selected-move-old-coded-full/verify.py
python3 -I -W error -O -B research/selected-move-old-coded-full/verify.py
python3 -I -W error -B research/selected-move-old-coded-full/check_admission.py --package research/selected-move-old-coded-full
python3 -I -W error -B research/selected-move-old-coded-full/check_composition.py --package research/selected-move-old-coded-full
```

VERIFY.json also registers both independent checks under -O. Expected
primary status: `PASS_OLD_CODED_COMPLETE_SELECTED_MOVE`. Primary normal and
optimized runs give identical receipts. Full r=2,w=4 and common-root-model
w=22 packets take 40,936,214 and 109,257,735 transitions. The output oracle
uses the unlowered source-frame kernel directly in old addresses, not the
executable factors, CNOT words or packing helpers.

Controls detect right-phase overflow, central nonintegrality, old-field
truncation, aliasing, all 32 source mutations, and two complete physically
returning programs with deleted absolute phase or translation. Separate
review derives the source-frame oracle without factor/verifier imports,
checks every translated instruction, ownership/guards, numerical admission
and exact cost inequalities, and independently re-extracts the full pinned
selected archive. Receipts and proof review are in the package.

No full f>1 or K>1 joined packet is claimed; two-column counterexamples are
exact sparse algebra. The all-size proof is the fixed-control/ABI induction
with the immutable uniform program contracts, not finite extrapolation.

## Publication checks

All six canonical registered commands, committed bytes/modes,32 exact origin-byte
comparisons and official export/input-integrity checks pass. Authored-file
whitespace passes; two trailing-blank warnings are preserved inside byte-frozen
predecessor inputs. The full-history gate is unavailable in the shallow checkout;
its success is not claimed. Direct base-parent and exact source checks are recorded
in PUBLICATION-CHECKS.json. No hosted CI result is claimed.

## Limitations and open obligations

This is a complete **single MOVE boundary**, under supplied old owners,
origins, blank windows, actual cutoff and numerical admission. It does not
locate owner415, produce the descriptor, certify root/grid provenance,
update the caller's frame ledger, join HOME/stock dispatch, retire failures,
or supply full recursive/nonleaf closure. Gamma6 preserves an arbitrary
common implicit quantum; header-shape agreement does not certify it.

No new kappa and no foundational-assumption discharge. The selected
conditional kappa remains 0.00363005817, with all five assumptions explicit.
No unconditional multiplication theorem is claimed.

CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#7578, the #7426/#7428/#7429/#7430 literal factors,

title: Construct orbit orderings with superpolynomial Gaussian tensor generator savings and explicit cost limits
body:
## What changed and why it matters

The preceding Gaussian tensor lower bounds fix lexicographic coordinate
order. This package constructs two arbitrary simultaneous row/column orders
with smaller ordinary Toeplitz generator bounds, and states the costs that
still prevent a runtime or unconditional-theorem claim.

The stronger family rotates disjoint blocks of distinct odd-prime lengths
p_i. For any repeated n-by-n factor B, n>=2, put T=n^d and P=product p_i.
The exact number of orbits is

`c=(T/P) product_i(1+(p_i-1)n^(1-p_i)) <= exp(8/9) T/P`.

Concatenating those orbits gives ordinary Stein rank and explicit ordinary
lower-times-upper Toeplitz generator count at most 2c, for both the forward
matrix and its inverse when it exists. Equality of factors within each block
suffices; arbitrary spectators are permitted. Common shifted factors, odd n
and nonsymmetric factors need no reversal symmetry or diagonal conversion.

For d>=8 choose k=floor(log2 d)-2 and Bertrand primes in (2^i,2^(i+1)). They
fit within d coordinates and have P>2^(k(k+1)/2). For identical Gaussian
factors the lexicographic minimum is 2T/n; the certified saving factor
P/(exp(8/9)n) grows faster than every fixed power of d for fixed n. This is
a representation saving, and the rank bound still grows with T.

The complementary even-n centrosymmetric construction uses complemented
rotation on ell power-of-two coordinates and gives the bound T/ell. Its
16-point binary example has exact forward/inverse rank 4 at q=1/2, versus
lexicographic rank 16. Either order may be preferable at a small parameter
point. Both proofs include explicit generators and inverse symmetry.

## Novelty and exact provenance

Canonical base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. SOURCES.json
contains six exact canonical Git-blob/SHA256 pins. The proof restates its
algebra, and the verifier has no external runtime inputs.

This addresses the arbitrary-coordinate-order question left by the
[rank package at 326844a](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/326844a3e0c570fdafa4f3737095cd37154743a6/research/tensor-gaussian-displacement-rank)
and [rounding-margin package at 575491d](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/575491d5fc353eac26010e45e9ced60fc9870017/research/gaussian-generator-rounding-margin).
It changes the shift through a permutation; it does not contradict either
fixed-order theorem.

The complemented-rotation automorphism and binary orbit-length fact are
credited to Gregor, Merino and Mütze,
[*The Hamilton Compression of Highly Symmetric Graphs*](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00026-023-00674-y),
section 3.3, equation (13), Lemma 3.4. They are not claimed new. The prime construction uses classical necklace
counting, coprime cyclic
products and Bertrand--Chebyshev prime existence, with primary credits to
[Moreau (1872)](https://www.numdam.org/item/NAM_1872_2_11__309_0/) and
[Erdős (1932)](https://www.renyi.hu/~p_erdos/1932-01.pdf). The scoped contribution
is the explicit ordinary-generator consequence, exact two-family kernel
scope, verified prime-family growth and paid cost/precision boundary. Preserve the
originating source authors' credit, including Vlado Vojdanovski's
capped-phase-fusion work. No literature-wide priority claim is made.

## Reproduction and executed checks

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/gaussian-orbit-generator-order/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/gaussian-orbit-generator-order/verify.py
python3 -I -W error -B research/gaussian-orbit-generator-order/prime_verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/gaussian-orbit-generator-order/prime_verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-orbit-generator-order --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-orbit-generator-order
```

Both verifiers passed normally and under optimization with identical JSON
per script. The original checks cover 15 rational fixtures, 30 targets and
22 literal reconstructions. Prime checks add nine direct cycle enumerations
compared with independent Burnside sums/product counts; six rational
fixtures, 12 targets and 12 literal reconstructions; a 256-point finite-field
full inverse and rank check; and ten finite Bertrand families through d=4096.

Fifteen primary failure controls detect unsupported cycle lengths, repeated
prime periods, broken within-block factor/shift equality, wrong gauge
orientation, unstructured perturbations, singular inversion, a forged rank
bound and a false correction constant. Finite tests do not prove the
universal prime theorem, global rank minimum or runtime claims.

## Independent review and publication checks

A separate standard-library Cartesian-necklace construction checks exact rational
Stein support for three full matrices, without importing either contributor
verifier. It rejects repeated-prime cycles and a false correction constant.
Both modes are registered; all six canonical commands pass. REVIEW.md records
the independent proof, inverse, growth, precision and complete-cost review.
Committed bytes/modes, canonical source pins, whitespace and official export
integrity pass. The full-history gate is unavailable in the shallow checkout;
no success is claimed for it. Exact provenance and direct base ancestry were
checked separately. No hosted CI result, human review or formal acceptance is
claimed.

## Costs, limitations and open obligations

Explicitly materializing the prime-family generators takes `Theta(T^2/P)`
scalar slots and still loses to direct axis application for fixed n as d
grows, because log P=O(log²d)=o(d). The complemented family has T^2/ell slots.
The proof
charges uniform order generation, fixed-tape sorting in both directions,
generator access, accumulation and restoration; it does not admit a native
repository controller or a complete three-transform recurrence.

Prime rotations directly preserve already matched shifts. Removing
unmatched shifts by diagonal conjugation instead has the paid range
`log cond_2(D)=sum_i (n_i-1)|log v_i|`. A black-box normwise conversion must
charge that precision. The package gives a narrowly scoped fixed-shift cap
obstruction; it does not silently undo the retained gauge-free construction
or claim unmatched shifted factors satisfy the prime symmetry.

The all-order minimum, fast implicit generator use, and a stable actual-source
caller remain open. **No new kappa:** selected #7000 remains
`363005817/100000000000`, conditional on all five inherited assumptions.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI ChatGPT assistance. The
orchestrator proposed the orbit and prime-block applications and scoped
precision obstruction;
the worker independently derived and checked the proof and costs, identified
the classical overlap and packaged the result. New files are Apache-2.0.
